title: The Zscaler MCP server's EASM tools: inventory, full records and documentation mismatches

prose.text: The MCP server wraps the Python SDK's EASM reads; toolsets, entitlement filtering and the untrusted-content banner are shared behavior ([[shared.mcp-server.tool-inventory]], [[shared.mcp-server.results]]).

prose.label: Documentation mismatches.
prose.text: The skill's argument names differ {{divergence:skill-arg-names}}, the tool guide describes an old wrapper {{divergence:org-docs-wrapper}}, and the tool list describes triage rows {{divergence:list-docs-triage}}.

prose.label: Trust.
prose.text: Which EASM tools carry the untrusted-content flag is in [[shared.mcp-server.results:untrusted-set]]; the finding description gap is in [[easm.findings]].

checks.do: Whether tool calls use org_id and lookalike_raw rather than the skill's organization_id and domain_id.

tools.statement: The MCP server has seven read-only EASM tools in three toolsets: `zeasm` (organizations), `zeasm_findings` (list, details, evidence, scan output) and `zeasm_lookalike_domains` (list, get).

unwrap-full-records.statement: The list tools unwrap the SDK collection's `results` and return each item's full `as_dict()` record; the get tools return the full record.

quotes: return shape_many([o.as_dict() for o in results])
return shape_many([f.as_dict() for f in results])
return shape_many([d.as_dict() for d in results])

arg-names.statement: The tools take `org_id` and, for the lookalike get, `lookalike_raw`.

skill-org-fields.statement: The review skill asks the agent to note each organization's monitored domains or assets and last scan date.

org-fields-unavailable.statement: Monitored-asset counts and last scan dates are not on organization records; per-asset first and last seen times come from the asset list, which no MCP tool calls.
org-fields-unavailable.conditions: Follows from the organization model (id and name) and the asset endpoints being API-only.

skill-arg-names.summary: The EASM review skill calls the tools with argument names the tools do not define.

positions.says: Calls use `organization_id` and, for the lookalike get, `domain_id`.

skill-arg-names.impact: An agent following the skill literally sends arguments the tool schema rejects; use org_id and the lookalike_raw domain name.

org-docs-wrapper.summary: The bundled tool guide says the organizations tool returns a results/total_results wrapper; the tool returns a list of organization rows.

positions.says: The result is a dictionary with `results` and `total_results`.
The tool unwraps `results` and returns one row per organization.

quotes: return shape_many([o.as_dict() for o in results])

org-docs-wrapper.impact: Code written against the guide's example (`orgs['results']`) fails; iterate the returned list.

list-docs-triage.summary: The supported-tools guide says the findings list returns a triage row rather than the raw SDK record; the tool returns the full record.

positions.says: One triage row per finding rather than the raw SDK record.

quotes: Returns one triage row per finding (id, category, type, status, risk level/score, impacted asset, first/last seen) rather than the raw SDK record.
return shape_many([f.as_dict() for f in results])

list-docs-triage.impact: Findings list rows include description and the scoring fields, which matters for token budgets and for the untrusted description text.
